favourite.heading: Why Utah can pull away
bullets: Utah is the better football team by 19.1 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+19.1 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 4.7 points to Utah (+4.7 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Utah State can keep it close
bullets: Depth: Utah State 53.7 (#4 of 68) vs Utah 52.3 (#60 of 68) — 56 places on the national board.
Receivers: Utah State 54.1 (#37 of 68) vs Utah 53.5 (#52 of 68) — 15 places on the national board.
